newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen weak, likely bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen weak, likely bargain hunting.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to remain weak on Wednesday with bargain hunting likely in some discounted blue-chip shares, brokers said.

"Market sentiment is still weak following a fall in share prices over the past few days," said one broker at foreign brokerage. "But bargain hunting might emerge today as some blue-chip shares had fallen to very attractive levels."
The composite SET index on Tuesday ended 18.84 points off at 614.19 on 6.2 billion baht trade.
Brokers said the strong support level will be at 600.
